hero.subtitle: Facility Design & Layout
hero.title: A Processing Facility Built for Transparency
hero.description: Every zone, every process, every compliance checkpoint — designed for efficiency and documented in Farm OS. This isn't just a building. It's the physical infrastructure of a tech-enabled cashew platform.

introduction.title: Designed for Data, Built for Scale
introduction.description: Our facility layout isn't just about workflow — it's about data capture. Every zone feeds information into Farm OS: intake weights, processing yields, quality metrics, and compliance documentation. When a buyer asks for traceability, the data is already there.

hygiene.title: Digitally Monitored Hygiene Zones
hygiene.description: Separate dirty and clean zones with Farm OS-logged sanitation schedules and ATP swab test results

efficiency.title: Data-Driven Workflow
efficiency.description: Linear production flow with every stage feeding metrics into Farm OS for continuous optimization

sustainability.title: Measurable Sustainability
sustainability.description: Energy and water usage tracked in Farm OS — not estimated, verified

flowchart.title: Facility Flowchart
flowchart.description: Interactive overview of our processing facility — every zone connected to Farm OS for real-time monitoring and traceability
flowchart.instructions: Click on any area to learn more about its function and how data flows to Farm OS

reception.description: Initial receiving area where raw nuts enter our Farm OS tracking system
features: Digital weighbridge — weight automatically logged to batch record
Quality sampling and moisture testing — results stored in Farm OS
Supplier batch ID assigned and linked to internal tracking
Documentation scanned and attached to digital batch file

storage.description: Climate-controlled storage with Farm OS inventory management
features: Ventilated warehouses with humidity sensors feeding data to Farm OS
FIFO inventory tracking — age and location of every batch known
Capacity for 500+ metric tons with digital stock levels
Pest control logs and monitoring schedules managed in Farm OS

dirtyZone.description: Initial processing — where raw nuts begin their documented journey
features: Dedicated cleaning and sorting zone with task tracking in Farm OS
Dust extraction systems with maintenance logs
Worker PPE compliance checks recorded digitally
Separate entry/exit to maintain zone integrity — access logged

cleanZone.description: Main processing area — the heart of our Farm OS-tracked operation
features: Positive air pressure monitored by sensors — data logged continuously
Hygiene stations with digital compliance check-ins
Food-grade stainless steel equipment with maintenance schedules in Farm OS
Temperature and humidity tracked per shift for quality assurance

grading.description: Quality control zone where kernel data is captured and analyzed
features: Electronic color sorters and size graders — results fed to Farm OS
Metal detection with automatic reject logging
Quality metrics per batch: grade distribution, defect rate, size profile
QC documentation auto-generated from Farm OS data

finished.description: Climate-controlled finished goods storage with full inventory tracking
features: Environment monitored 24/7 (15-18°C, 50-60% RH) — alerts in Farm OS
FIFO system with barcode scanning linked to batch records
Secure access with digital entry logs
Inventory levels visible in real-time on Farm OS dashboard

dispatch.description: Export preparation — where batch data becomes shipping documentation
features: Loading bay with container tracking in Farm OS
Export documentation auto-generated from batch data
Final QC checkpoint with digital sign-off
Container seal numbers recorded and linked to batch ID

locker.description: Staff hygiene and changing facilities with compliance tracking
features: Separate male/female changing rooms with digital access
Personal locker allocation managed in HR system
Uniform distribution tracked per employee
Sanitation schedule logged in Farm OS

prayer.description: Dedicated prayer space — part of our commitment to worker dignity
features: Separate prayer rooms for men and women
Ablution facilities with running water
Qibla direction clearly marked
Quiet, clean environment — maintained on digital cleaning schedule

training.description: Where our team learns to use Farm OS and processing equipment
features: Audio-visual equipment for Farm OS training sessions
Capacity for 30+ people
Training records tracked per employee in HR system
Certification tracking for food safety and equipment operation

canteen.description: Staff dining area with hygiene monitoring
features: Hygienic food preparation area with digital temperature logs
Seating for 50+ staff members
Cleaning schedule managed in Farm OS
Outdoor seating area

water.description: Water management — usage tracked for sustainability reporting
features: Reverse osmosis purification with flow meters feeding Farm OS
Water recycling metrics tracked for ESG reporting
Borehole with backup supply — levels monitored
Water quality testing results stored digitally

energy.description: Energy systems — where sustainability meets data
features: Biomass boiler using cashew shells — fuel consumption tracked
Solar PV output monitored in real-time on Farm OS dashboard
Backup generator with automated test schedules
Energy consumption per batch calculated for cost analysis

expansion.description: Future growth area — infrastructure ready for Farm OS scaling
features: Pre-planned utility connections for additional processing lines
Space allocated for cold storage — monitoring infrastructure pre-wired
Scalable network and sensor infrastructure
Designed to double capacity without disrupting operations

compliance.title: Compliance & Standards — Digitally Documented
compliance.description: Our processing facility is designed to meet international standards — and Farm OS creates the audit trail to prove it.

hygiene.title: Hygiene & Sanitation Protocols
features: SSOPs aligned with Codex Alimentarius — checklists managed in Farm OS
Automated hand-washing and boot-sanitizing stations — usage logged
Drainage with 2% slope and rodent-proof gratings — inspection records digital
Separate raw material and finished goods zones — access controlled and logged
Daily ATP swab testing — results stored in Farm OS for auditor review

certifications.title: Certifications In Progress
certifications.description: Every certification requires an audit trail. Farm OS builds that trail automatically.
standards: ISO 22000 Food Safety Management — digital HACCP records, targeting 2029
Halal Compliance — documented ingredient sourcing and process segregation, targeting 2028
Organic Processing (ECOCERT) — 3-year input tracking in Farm OS, targeting 2030
Fair Trade and Rainforest Alliance — digital labor and environmental records

qualityLab.note: All test results stored in Farm OS and available per batch for buyer verification

workerWelfare.title: Worker Safety & Welfare — Tracked, Not Just Promised
workerWelfare.subtitle: Our team is our greatest asset — and their safety is documented

features.details: Gloves, aprons, safety glasses, dust masks — distribution tracked per employee
Digital check-in at sanitation stations, compliance monitored per shift
Designed to reduce strain — workstation assessments documented
On-site first aid, trained responders, incident reports logged digitally
Above minimum wage, digital payroll, overtime tracked in HR system
Farm OS and equipment training — completion tracked per employee
